entry.title: NSF GRFP
entry.content: I am honored to announce that I have accepted an award through the NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program. I would like to thank Professor Radway (UPenn), Professor Stan (UVA), and Professor Venkat (UVA) for their support and guidance throughout the process. I look forward to continuing my research under the direction of Dr. Radway in the co-design of hardware accelerators and emerging memory architectures.
